$comment: The DOM-free check, the same mechanical rule @chatlychat/core uses. lib is ES2022 ONLY and `types` is empty, so a `window`, `document`, `localStorage` or `process` reference in non-spec source is a compile error rather than a code-review item. This kit runs in jsdom, in page.evaluate and in a bare Node process, so it must name none of those globals and take them as arguments instead — see src/host.ts.
